<!--
See CONTRIBUTING.md before filing this. A few ground rules:

- No exploit payloads, no live/working secrets, no proof-of-concept that
  could be copy-pasted to cause harm. Describe the issue, don't weaponize it.
- This repo has no bug bounty program -- filing here means a public report,
  visible to anyone. If the issue is severe enough that you'd rather not
  disclose it publicly first, say so below and skip the technical detail
  until you hear back.
-->

**What did you find?**
Plain description of the issue -- what's wrong, and why it matters.

**Where in the codebase?**
File path(s) / component(s), if you know them.

**Impact**
What could go wrong if this isn't fixed -- worst realistic case, not a
worst-case fantasy.

**Suggested fix (optional)**
If you already have an idea, share it -- not required.
